gloss_en: Pe'er — glory/splendor as sacred adornment: the noun פְּאֵר meaning beauty-of-glory, identified with the tefillin worn on the head (per 'פארך חבוש עליך'), the radiant crowning glory linked to the mochin and the Name of God resting upon Israel (not the verb לפאר 'to glorify' nor the tree פארה/branch)
